publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Scientific algorithmic teaching reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, molecular measurement, protein structure, laboratory result, biomarker result, treatment recommendation, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: Current ChEBI, PubChem, ExPASy ENZYME, Rhea, reviewed UniProtKB, NCBI Gene, and NLM MeSH records supply controlled identity and conservative representation boundaries only; no source image or design is copied.

reviewStandard: Six deterministic mechanism routes are audited against current controlled authorities. Exactly one independent call is permitted for each hash-frozen prompt. Every output remains review-only pending literal native-resolution structure accounting, prohibited-content and source-safe-field checks, exact hash, separate acceptance, metadata reconciliation, social crop review, and all release gates.
promotionRule: Only a revision-1 output matching its frozen identity, conservative teaching boundary, fully opaque flat pale field, literal object counts, and centered source-safe area may proceed to separate exact-hash Control Tower acceptance. Prompt intent is never evidence of output content.
